fields.name: 1 canonical authority, object and exact theorem targets

rows.title: Word wrapping add, sub and mul

canonical.object: The ZMod (2^64) commutative ring under the bit-pattern denotation denote: addition, subtraction and multiplication are total, pure and wrapping on every 64-bit pattern. The two-slot algebra's operations are the canonical Apeiron.Trichotomy.AnyRing.ringMul and ringNormForm; ringNormForm_mul, ringMul_comm and ringMul_assoc are the ring laws the wrapping word operations instantiate. No order, no division and no nonnegativity is used.

entry_points.song_absent: Song side NONE (blocker BC1): Song mergeAcc is a bounded machine-integer addition on 0 <= v <= COORD_CEILING in song/src/table/table.slang, not the full-width wrapping word ring, and Song has no wrapping subtraction or multiplication.

rows.matched_domain: Every pair of i64 words for add, sub and mul: every 64-bit pattern; total wrapping, no refusal.

representation_invariant.constructor: The Rust scalar is the i64 bit pattern; the Ring for i64 instance in src/scalar.rs is the constructor of the word ring. There is no state.
representation_invariant.statement: denote : I64 -> ZMod (2^64) reads the bit pattern (unsigned), so the extracted core.num.I64.wrapping_add, wrapping_sub and wrapping_mul denote +, - and * in ZMod (2^64). RingCell (ZMod (2^64)) is the two-slot carrier type.
representation_invariant.state_effects: None: the three operations are pure and stateless.

rust.predicate: Total: every (i64, i64) pair is admitted for add, sub and mul; there is no refusal and no precondition.

song.predicate: Song side NONE (blocker BC1); there is no executing Song admission predicate for the full-width wrapping word ring.

admission.joint: Joint success requires both admission predicates; because the Song implementation is absent, the joint domain is empty and no correspondence is claimed.

behavior.success: The extracted wrapping_add, wrapping_sub and wrapping_mul return a bare i64 word for every input; the result is the ring operation under denote.
behavior.resource_exhaustion: Not applicable: a fixed-width wrapping operation cannot exhaust a resource.
behavior.raw_return_encoding: A bare i64 word with no success tag; wrapping is the defined result, not a failure.
behavior.post_state: No state: the operations are pure.

rows.title: Cell multiplication and norm form

canonical.object: ringMul sigma z w = (z.1 * w.1 + sigma * z.2 * w.2, z.1 * w.2 + z.2 * w.1) and ringNormForm sigma z = z.1^2 - sigma * z.2^2 on RingCell R = R x R. ringNormForm_mul states the norm form is multiplicative. The dial sigma is exactly {-1, 0, 1}: elliptic, parabolic and hyperbolic.

rust.role: the norm form a^2 - sigma b^2

rows.matched_domain: Every pair of Cell<i64> (each slot any 64-bit pattern) and every dial in {Elliptic, Parabolic, Hyperbolic}; componentwise, total wrapping.

representation_invariant.constructor: Cell::new(a, b) constructs the ordered pair; Sigma::value maps the dial to -1, 0 or 1. There is no state.
representation_invariant.statement: denoteCell maps a Cell<i64> to a RingCell (ZMod (2^64)) by denoting each slot, and denoteSigma maps the dial by sigmaI64. The extracted word_mul and word_norm are the real src/cell.rs::Cell::mul and Cell::norm_form bodies instantiated at the i64 Ring.
representation_invariant.state_effects: None: both operations are pure and stateless.

rows.title: Exact half-flux

canonical.object: DoublesTo q x := 2 * q = x and exactHalfFlux f left right := DoublesTo f (left - right): the exact half -(right - left) / 2 written with no division. exactHalfFlux_iff reads the definition back and exactHalfFlux_neg reads it as 2 * f = -(right - left).

rows.matched_domain: Signed i64 left and right; the half-flux exists exactly when right - left fits i64 and is even; an odd or unrepresentable difference is refused.

representation_invariant.constructor: diffusive_flux_half is the generic src/carrier.rs body instantiated at R = i64 by proof/extract/lib.rs::word_diffusive_flux_half; it selects the signed quotient 0 - ((right - left) / 2).
representation_invariant.statement: On success the extracted result satisfies the canonical Apeiron.Physics.exactHalfFlux witness 2 * f = left - right; the selected output is the signed quotient, which is the extra selection a bare witness does not determine in ZMod (2^64).

rows.title: Three-cell diffusive line

canonical.object: The three-cell line is scalarCarrierStep on each of the three cells with the two interior faces the exactHalfFlux values -(center - left) / 2 and -(right - center) / 2, read once each and shared, and the two endpoint faces closed at zero. The corpus any-ring three-cell theorem Apeiron.Physics.diffusiveUpdate_half_three_anyRing is not used: its hypothesis DoublesTo nu 1 is unsatisfiable in ZMod (2^64) because 2 is not invertible, so the extracted line carries the face value directly.

hazards.statement: Two witnesses in ZMod (2^64) need not be equal: the doubling witness 2 * f = left - right does not determine a unique f because 2 is a zero divisor in ZMod (2^64).
hazards.consequence: The canonical exactHalfFlux witness is not enough for joint output equality; the Rust kernel selects the signed quotient 0 - ((right - left) / 2), and that selection is an additional obligation the refinement records.

hazards.statement: DoublesTo nu 1 is unsatisfiable in ZMod (2^64): reducing 2 * nu = 1 modulo 2 gives 0 = 1, so the corpus any-ring three-cell theorem diffusiveUpdate_half_three_anyRing is vacuous at the bridge's ring.
hazards.consequence: The three-cell line's canonical targets are scalarCarrierStep and exactHalfFlux, not diffusiveUpdate_half_three_anyRing; the extracted line carries the face value directly.

hazards.statement: The conservative step and the exact half-flux are partial: an unrepresentable intermediate or an odd face difference returns None.
hazards.consequence: No theorem claims totality; the refinement is conditional on the generated no-overflow preconditions and the representability and evenness hypotheses, and the refusal witnesses show the partiality is real.

hazards.statement: The Rust kernels are generic over the crate's Ring contract, which is a behavioral contract and not a type-level proof; a partial scalar such as Dyadic can panic.
hazards.consequence: Only the i64 wrapping execution is extracted; the generic identities are conditioned on lawful and successful operations, and no claim transfers to Dyadic.

hazards.statement: Every carrier and exchange row has an unmatched Song counterpart (BC1 to BC4): Song has no executing primitive for the word ring, the two-slot algebra, the carrier readout or the exchange.
hazards.consequence: There is no matched Song domain and no joint refinement for any row; no interval-propagation substitute is accepted. Every row stays selected-open.

controls.name: wrong wrapping operation
controls.mutation: In a throwaway copy of proof/Denotation.lean, replace the body of denote_wrapping_add with the subtraction identity, or replace the extracted wrapping_add with a checked or non-wrapping addition.
controls.expected_red: denote_wrapping_add must fail: the extracted word addition no longer denotes ZMod (2^64) addition.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: wrong dial or crossed output slot
controls.mutation: In a throwaway copy of src/cell.rs, change the hyperbolic dial value from 1 to 2, or cross the two output slots so the first slot is z.1 * w.2 + z.2 * w.1.
controls.expected_red: word_mul_denote and word_norm_mul must fail: the extracted product no longer denotes ringMul at the dial, and the norm form is no longer multiplicative.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

integration_order: K1 word wrapping add, sub and mul: the base ring the cell algebra is built over; the denotation identities are the first source-connected link.
K2 cell multiplication and norm form: the dial-parameterised product and the multiplicative norm form; the blocker BC2 records the missing Song two-slot algebra.
K3 point density and flux: the carrier readout over the cell algebra.
K4 conservative scalar update and K5 exact half-flux: the partial exact kernels; H1 records the witness non-uniqueness and the signed quotient selection.
K6 three-cell diffusive line: the composition of K4 and K5; H2 records why the corpus any-ring three-cell theorem is not the target.
K7 exchange and claimed impulse: the arithmetic exchange and the checked-claim kernel.
A vertical lift or a Song carrier/exchange implementation only after a matched Song primitive exists; no interval-propagation substitute discharges a blocker.
not_covered: rustc/LLVM code generation and the generated machine code.
